name: Proxmox VE
description: Connects an agent to a Proxmox VE instance (several agents = several instances): a dedicated Proxmox dashboard with VMs, LXC containers, storage, users, nodes and tasks; start/stop guests, snapshots, backups, configuration, console and API explorer. Address local, custom or via the RMM relay (tunnel through the agent); login via API token or user + password. Per-agent permissions plus "standard Proxmox".
author: BYTERA

settings.label: Match automatically
settings.help: Regularly compare agents with the VMs/CTs of the connected Proxmox hosts (also shortly after adding/moving an agent).

settings.label: Match by IP address
settings.help: Only when exactly one guest has this IP.

settings.label: Match by hostname
settings.help: Hostname matches are always only a suggestion.

settings.label: Map safe matches immediately
settings.help: Sort MAC/IP matches as VM/CT without asking and subordinate them to the head of the Proxmox node.
